scope.execution: Python AST parsing, pure constant registry evaluation, small frozen seals and a separately recorded string-only helper fixture
scope.edit_authorization: Root explicitly approved reporting-only CSV identity coverage correction; existing scientific formulas, tolerances and protocol were preserved

findings.original_problem: Length checks plus per-visited-row numeric checks allowed a valid CSV identity to be duplicated while another identity vanished. Total rows and all visited values could still match. Paired CSV counted unique keys but did not require the frozen contrast/population/frame Cartesian set.
findings.correction: Require exact declared tuple sets and one row each for ROW_METRICS, COMPARISON_ALL_ARMS, ACTION_SOURCE_COUNTS, PAIRED_TRANSITIONS, CANDIDATE_COVERAGE, HISTORICAL_STRATA, FACTOR_AND_PAIR_COUNTS and GAIN_DAMAGE_ACTUAL_SOURCE. ROW_METRICS metadata/session/cluster and stored success/availability are also checked directly against independent rows.
findings.evidence: AST-extracted helper,25 constructed valid/duplicate/foreign-key/cross-population ID swap fixtures; no campaign run, reference, candidate or score decoded

findings.original_problem: New E0 output used outer fallback=False for every frame although the actual regenerated pose can be a documented coarse/BI fallback with joint_feasible=False. Its pose was preserved but status counts would falsely report no E0 fallbacks.
findings.correction: Root now propagates actual e0_regenerated.fallback and joint_feasible to outer fallback/accepted. Pose, choice, metric and threshold were not changed.

findings.original_problem: Guide ran independent_numeric immediately after evaluate, but checker requires posthoc_v1/HISTORICAL_STRATA.csv.
findings.correction: Guide now invokes actual posthoc CLI with --oracle-root before independent_numeric.

findings.original_problem: Fixed 2x2/pair factor-count CSV and actual-source gain/damage CSV were not independently verified.
findings.correction: Their identity coverage and original count definitions are now reconstructed from independently scored rows. This adds verification of existing statistics, not a new scientific contrast or selector.

verified_static_contracts: Assembler uses authoritative original id/partition/session/cluster metadata, exact238 unique IDs and all37 arm inventory; new B/L metadata and the one common real feature SHA are enforced. Historical null metadata does not overwrite canonical output identity.
Prediction seal and final root scoring gate precede the first evaluator reference JSON decode. Registered arms and canonical protocol bytes are checked, with complete49/143/separate46 denominators.

Production metric uses raw original physical GT rotation without orthogonalization, exactly I and Y(pi) C2, center centimeters and joint<=5cm/5degree success. A malformed/unavailable pose remains an explicit full-denominator failure.

Sample variance/SD are ddof1, quantiles are linear, tails are untrimmed, missing poses remain binary failures and continuous moments are available-only. Binary recovery/damage remains distinct from both-failure continuous changes.

Independent arithmetic imports NumPy/stdlib implementation independent_check and pure registry; no producer/evaluator/optimizer or production metric/aggregator import. It uses own fsum/atan2 values and separately replays original floating expression for strict delta signs without changing success criteria.

Independent candidate success uses saved fixed poses only; feasibility is delegated to the separate independent finite audit. Model action helpers are used only by the production diagnosis, not independent candidate arithmetic.
Historical strata are decoded only postseal, keep original114/10/22/46 primary classes and membership aliases, and cannot become producer/model inputs. CAL remains separate.
Seed descriptions use the same fixed3 seeds and one dataset. Frozen population, bootstrap draw schedule, cluster units, representative seed and registered contrast list are unchanged.
remaining_runtime_checks: Run the newly sealed assembler with actual completed B/L/common-bank outputs and preserve any schema failure.
Verify full source/output seals and budget gate before first new real-reference scoring.
Run evaluator then posthoc then independent numeric; require all37 methods and all192/49/143/CAL46 populations and the full exact CSV tuple sets.
Actual pose numeric differences, strict expression signs, class membership, source aliases, candidate success/eligibility and all aggregate/CI values remain unobserved by this static review.
This source review does not verify physical ownership of mask/line support, independent external test performance, image privacy pixels or remote publication.
